import asyncio

async def greet_async(name):
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    return f'Hello, {name}'

print(asyncio.run(greet_async('World')))

import asyncio

async def task_a():
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    return 'A'

async def task_b():
    await asyncio.sleep(0)
    return 'B'

async def main():
    return await asyncio.gather(task_a(), task_b())

result = asyncio.run(main())
print(result)
